title: Tiny, cute skateboard
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- deck shadow/base edge -->
  <rect x="14" y="57" width="72" height="12" rx="6" fill="#8a4bd1"/>
  <!-- deck top -->
  <rect x="14" y="53" width="72" height="12" rx="6" fill="#c86bff"/>
  <!-- deck bright highlight -->
  <rect x="18" y="54" width="64" height="4" rx="2" fill="#e9b7ff"/>
  <!-- kicktail shading left -->
  <path d="M14 59 Q10 65 14 65 L20 65 Q16 61 20 56 Z" fill="#a94ce0"/>
  <!-- kicktail shading right -->
  <path d="M86 59 Q90 65 86 65 L80 65 Q84 61 80 56 Z" fill="#a94ce0"/>
  <!-- front truck -->
  <rect x="66" y="65" width="12" height="4" rx="1" fill="#4fc3f7"/>
  <rect x="69" y="69" width="6" height="4" rx="1" fill="#29a8e0"/>
  <!-- rear truck -->
  <rect x="22" y="65" width="12" height="4" rx="1" fill="#4fc3f7"/>
  <rect x="25" y="69" width="6" height="4" rx="1" fill="#29a8e0"/>
  <!-- rear wheels -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="76" r="7" fill="#ffd54f"/>
  <circle cx="28" cy="76" r="4" fill="#ffab00"/>
  <circle cx="28" cy="76" r="1.5" fill="#fff3c4"/>
  <!-- front wheels -->
  <circle cx="72" cy="76" r="7" fill="#ffd54f"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="76" r="4" fill="#ffab00"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="76" r="1.5" fill="#fff3c4"/>
  <!-- cute face on deck: happy eyes -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="58" r="3" fill="#2a0f4d"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="58" r="3" fill="#2a0f4d"/>
  <circle cx="42" cy="56.5" r="1.2" fill="#e9b7ff"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="56.5" r="1.2" fill="#e9b7ff"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M44 62 Q50 67 56 62" stroke="#2a0f4d" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- little blush -->
  <circle cx="36" cy="62" r="3" fill="#ff7ab8" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="62" r="3" fill="#ff7ab8" opacity="0.7"/>
</svg>
